mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.category_name_id, m.model_version, m.model_status, m.db_id, m.table_name, m.table_name_cn, m.safety_level, m.update_log, m.is_delete, m.create_date, m.update_date, m.remark, m.relation_main_db_id, m.relation_main_table_id, m.relation_main_table_alias, m.audit_mode, m.access_mode, d.db_username as relation_main_db_username, d.db_name as relation_main_db_name , d.db_name_cn as relation_main_db_name_cn , t.table_name as relation_main_table_name, t.table_name_cn as relation_main_table_name_cn FROM t_meta_model m left join t_db_config d on m.relation_main_db_id=d.id left join t_db_table t on m.relation_main_table_id = t.id where m.id = #{id}
mapper.sql: select id, category_name_id, model_version, model_status, db_id, table_name, table_name_cn, safety_level, update_log, is_delete, create_date, update_date, remark, relation_main_db_id, relation_main_table_id, relation_main_table_alias , audit_mode, access_mode, data_storage_mode, data_relation_type from t_meta_model
mapper.select: SELECT table_name tableName, table_name_cn tableNameCn, model_version modelVersion, model_status modelStatus,update_log updateLog,category_name_id cateGoryNameId, audit_mode auditMode, access_mode accessMode, data_relation_type dataRelationType, data_storage_mode dataStorageMode FROM t_meta_model WHERE id = #{modelId}

select c.category_name remark, m.id id, m.table_name tableName, m.category_name_id as categoryNameId,m.table_name_cn as tableNameCn FROM t_meta_model m left JOIN t_meta_model_category c on m.category_name_id=c.id where m.is_delete=0
SELECT table_name FROM t_meta_model WHERE is_delete = '0' and table_name = #{tableName}

SELECT md.table_name tableName, tb.table_name rlTableName FROM t_meta_model md LEFT JOIN t_db_table tb ON tb.id = md.relation_main_table_id WHERE md.id = #{modelId} and md.model_version=#{modelVersion}

select if(c.category_name_cn is null,'其他',c.category_name_cn)remark, m.id id, m.table_name_cn tableName, m.category_name_id as categoryNameId,m.table_name as tableNameCn FROM t_meta_model m left JOIN t_meta_model_category c on m.category_name_id=c.id where m.is_delete=0

select if(c.category_name_cn is null,'其他',c.category_name_cn)remark, m.id id, m.table_name_cn tableName, m.category_name_id as categoryNameId,m.table_name as tableNameCn FROM t_meta_model m left JOIN t_meta_model_category c on m.category_name_id=c.id where m.is_delete=0 and (table_name like concat('%',#{tableName},'%') or table_name_cn like concat('%',#{tableName},'%'))

select if(c.category_name_cn is null,'其他',c.category_name_cn)remark, m.id id, m.table_name tableName, m.category_name_id as categoryNameId,m.table_name_cn as tableNameCn FROM t_meta_model m left JOIN t_meta_model_category c on m.category_name_id=c.id where m.is_delete=0 and m.table_name not in ( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(invoke_target,"'",2) ,"'",-1) FROM sys_job )

select if(c.category_name_cn is null,'其他',c.category_name_cn)remark, m.id id, m.table_name tableName, m.category_name_id as categoryNameId,m.table_name_cn as tableNameCn FROM t_meta_model m left JOIN t_meta_model_category c on m.category_name_id=c.id where m.is_delete=0 and m.id not in (select distinct r.model_id from t_meta_model_id_rule r where r.model_id is not null)

mapper.select: select t.id as modelId, t.model_version modelVersion from t_meta_model t where t.table_name = #{tableName}
SELECT CONCAT( cf.db_username, '.', tb.table_name ) FROM t_db_table tb LEFT JOIN t_db_config cf ON cf.id = tb.db_id WHERE tb.id = #{tableId}

select m.relation_main_db_id as relationMainDbId, c.db_name as dbName, c.db_username dbUsername, c.db_type dbType FROM t_meta_model m join t_db_config c on m.relation_main_db_id = c.id where m.id = #{id}

select distinct r.relation_db_id relationDbId, r.relation_table_id relationTableId, c.db_name as dbName, c.db_username dbUsername, c.db_type dbType FROM t_meta_model_relation r LEFT JOIN t_db_config c ON r.relation_db_id = c.id where r.model_id = #{id}
